Item 8.01 Other Events
On November 4, 2026, BWX Technologies,
Inc. (the “Company”) issued a press release announcing that it had launched a private offering of $500 million in aggregate
principal amount of senior notes due 2034. Additionally, on November 4, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing that it had
commenced (i) concurrent cash tender offers for any and all of its outstanding 4.125% Senior Notes due 2028 (the “2028 Notes”)
and 4.125% Senior Notes due 2029 (the “2029 Notes” and, together with the 2028 Notes, the “Notes”) and (ii) solicitations
of consents to certain proposed amendments to each of the indentures governing the Notes. Copies of the press releases are filed as Exhibits
99.1 and 99.2 to this Current Report on Form 8-K.
heads.EX-99.1:
Exhibit
99.1
BWX
Technologies, Inc. Announces Proposed Offering of Senior Notes
(LYNCHBURG, Va. – Nov. 4, 2026) BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT) announced today that it has launched an offering of $500
million aggregate principal amount of senior unsecured notes due 2034 (the “Notes”) in a private transaction exempt from
the registration requirements of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Act”). The Notes will be guaranteed by each
of BWXT’s present and future wholly-owned subsidiaries that are obligors under its existing credit agreement.
BWXT
intends to use the net proceeds from the Notes, together with cash on hand, to fund the purchase of all 4.125% Senior Notes due 2028
(the “2028 Notes”) and 4.125% Senior Notes due 2029 (the “2029 Notes” and, together with the 2028 Notes, the
“Existing Notes”) that are validly tendered and accepted for purchase in BWXT’s concurrent cash tender offer for any
and all Existing Notes and related consent solicitation (the “Tender Offer”), to effect the satisfaction and discharge of
the indentures governing the Existing Notes and any Existing Notes that are not purchased in the Tender Offer, and to pay the costs and
expenses incurred in
heads.EX-99.2:
Exhibit
99.2
BWX Technologies, Inc. Launches Cash Tender Offers and Consent Solicitations for its 4.125% Senior Notes due 2028 and 4.125% Senior Notes
due 2029
(LYNCHBURG, Va. – Nov. 4, 2026) BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT) (“BWXT”) announced today that it has commenced
(i) offers to purchase for cash (the “Offers”) from each holder and beneficial owner (each, a “Holder”) any and
all of its outstanding 4.125% Senior Notes due 2028 (CUSIP Nos. 05605H AB6 / U12213 AB7) (the “2028 Notes”) and 4.125% Senior
Notes due 2029 (CUSIP Nos. 05605H AC4 / U12213 AC5) (the “2029 Notes” and, together with the 2028 Notes, the “Notes”
and each, a “Series”) and (ii) solicitations (the “Solicitations”) of consents (“Consents”) to certain
proposed amendments to each of the indentures governing the Notes (as amended or supplemented, the “Indentures”), as described
below. The Offers and the Solicitations are being made on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in the Offer to Purchase
and Consent Solicitation Statement, dated the date hereof (the “Statement”). Capitalized terms used but not defined in this
press release have the meanings given to them in the Statement.
